title: Rebuilding the Altar

questions.question: In which month did the people gather as one man to Jerusalem?
questions.explanation: Ezra 3:1 (ESV): "When the seventh month came... the people gathered as one man to Jerusalem."

questions.question: Who built the altar of the God of Israel?
options: Jeshua the son of Jozadak and his brothers... and Zerubbabel
questions.correctAnswer: Jeshua the son of Jozadak and his brothers... and Zerubbabel
questions.explanation: Ezra 3:2 (ESV): "Then arose Jeshua the son of Jozadak... and Zerubbabel..."

questions.question: What festival did they keep?
questions.explanation: Ezra 3:4 (ESV): "And they kept the Feast of Booths..."

questions.question: When was the foundation of the temple of the LORD laid?
options: In the second year... in the second month
questions.correctAnswer: In the second year... in the second month
questions.explanation: Ezra 3:8 (ESV): "Now in the second year... in the second month... they began..."

questions.question: What was the reaction of the people when the foundation was laid?
options: They shouted with a great shout, and many wept
questions.correctAnswer: They shouted with a great shout, and many wept
questions.explanation: Ezra 3:11-12 (ESV): "...all the people shouted... But many... wept with a loud voice..."

questions.question: Who appointed the Levites to supervise the work?
questions.explanation: Ezra 3:8 (ESV): "...Zerubbabel... and Jeshua... appointed the Levites..."

questions.question: What was the minimum age for Levites to supervise the work?
questions.explanation: Ezra 3:8 (ESV): "...from twenty years old and upward..."

questions.question: From where did they bring cedar trees?
questions.explanation: Ezra 3:7 (ESV): "...to bring cedar trees from Lebanon to the sea..."

questions.question: To where were the trees brought by sea?
questions.explanation: Ezra 3:7 (ESV): "...from Lebanon to the sea, to Joppa..."

questions.question: According to whose direction did they praise the LORD?
questions.explanation: Ezra 3:10 (ESV): "...to praise the LORD, according to the directions of David king of Israel."

questions.question: Why did they set the altar in its place?
options: For fear was upon them because of the peoples of the lands
questions.correctAnswer: For fear was upon them because of the peoples of the lands
questions.explanation: Ezra 3:3 (ESV): "They set the altar in its place, for fear was upon them because of the peoples of the lands..."

questions.question: What grant permitted them to bring the cedars?
options: The grant of Cyrus king of Persia
questions.correctAnswer: The grant of Cyrus king of Persia
questions.explanation: Ezra 3:7 (ESV): "...according to the grant that they had from Cyrus king of Persia."

questions.question: Who supervised the workmen in the house of God?
options: Jeshua with his sons and his brothers, and Kadmiel and his sons
questions.correctAnswer: Jeshua with his sons and his brothers, and Kadmiel and his sons
questions.explanation: Ezra 3:9 (ESV): "And Jeshua with his sons and his brothers, and Kadmiel and his sons... together supervised the workmen..."

questions.question: What refrain did they sing responsively?
options: For he is good, for his steadfast love endures forever toward Israel
questions.correctAnswer: For he is good, for his steadfast love endures forever toward Israel
questions.explanation: Ezra 3:11 (ESV): "And they sang responsively... 'For he is good, for his steadfast love endures forever toward Israel.'"

questions.question: Could the people distinguish the sound of the shout of joy from the sound of weeping?
questions.explanation: Ezra 3:13 (ESV): "so that the people could not distinguish the sound of the joyful shout from the sound of the people's weeping..."

key_verse_text: And they sang responsively, praising and giving thanks to the LORD, “For he is good, for his steadfast love endures forever toward Israel.” And all the people shouted with a great shout when they praised the LORD, because the foundation of the house of the LORD was laid.
